en.tagline: Design and check YouTube thumbnails with AI image generation
en.summary: This skill guides YouTube thumbnail design. It gives the required sizes, safe zones, color and text rules, and face expression guidance. It also uses the belt CLI from inference.sh to generate thumbnail images from prompts.
problem: Most viewers see a YouTube thumbnail at about 120px wide on mobile. At that size, a thumbnail with thin text, low contrast, or too many elements becomes hard to read and gets skipped.
With this skill, you follow fixed specs and rules, check the design at 120px, and generate image variants with belt. You can then compare variants one variable at a time.
fit: Making a new YouTube thumbnail with AI image generation
Checking an existing thumbnail against size, file, and safe zone rules
Creating A/B test variants that change one thing, such as background or expression
unfit: You do not use inference.sh or the belt CLI
You need thumbnails for platforms other than YouTube
steps: Write a prompt that sets the subject, expression, colors, and lighting, and run `belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora` with width 1280 and height 720.
Check the image against the specs: 16:9, at least 1280 x 720 (1920 x 1080 preferred), under 2 MB, and JPG, GIF, or PNG.
Place key elements away from the bottom-right timestamp and bottom-left chapter markers, and keep text to 6 words or fewer.
View the thumbnail at 120px width and redesign it if it looks like a muddy blur.
For A/B tests, generate each variant with `--no-wait`, changing only one variable between them.

zh.tagline: 用 AI 生成并检查 YouTube 缩略图
zh.summary: 这个技能用于设计 YouTube 缩略图。它提供尺寸要求、安全区、配色和文字规则，以及人脸表情建议。它还通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI，根据提示词生成缩略图图片。
problem: 多数观众在手机上看到 YouTube 缩略图时，宽度约为 120 像素。在这个尺寸下，细文字、低对比度或元素过多的缩略图很难看清，容易被划过。
使用这个技能后，你可以按固定规格和规则操作，在 120 像素宽度下检查设计，并用 belt 生成图片变体。之后每次只改一个变量，对比各个版本。
fit: 用 AI 图片生成制作新的 YouTube 缩略图
对照尺寸、文件和安全区规则检查已有缩略图
制作 A/B 测试变体，每次只改变背景或表情等一项
unfit: 你不使用 inference.sh 或 belt CLI
你需要的缩略图不是给 YouTube 用的
steps: 编写提示词，写明主体、表情、配色和光线，然后用宽 1280、高 720 运行 `belt app run falai/flux-dev-lora`。
按规格检查图片：16:9 比例，不小于 1280 x 720（推荐 1920 x 1080），文件小于 2 MB，格式为 JPG、GIF 或 PNG。
把关键元素放在右下角时长标记和左下角章节标记之外，文字不超过 6 个词。
在 120 像素宽度下查看缩略图，如果看起来模糊不清，就重新设计。
做 A/B 测试时，用 `--no-wait` 生成每个变体，两个版本之间只改一个变量。
